name: Final project: Creative Core - Enter The Portal
author: Amario92
description:
My final project for the Creative Core Unity course. It features and showcases many of the things I learned during the course.
Although this project took me a long time to create, there are still things I wish I could've done better and things that I could've implemented to enrich the user experience.
However, I'm glad it's done!

WebGL has a bug at the start of the game that prevents you from looking around. Simply start the game then exit fullscreen and then fullscreen again and click the mouse to remove the cursor!

The project is called 'Enter The Portal' and it's a 3D platformer. There are two levels with one bonus level where I tweaked the camera angle to give the user a different perspective.
Simply guide the character through the portal to progress to the next level.
I wanted to make fun-looking levels for the user to explore and feel at ease with.

I did make a third level but the scope and vision of it changed as it became too big!

The assets were from the asset store and the music was from opengameart.org
